description: Aeroportos is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). A classe está inserida na Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais do Brasil (INDE). Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Brazil, transportation. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
